observations.result: 33 tests and 129 expectations pass across VaultStore, conservative three-way merge, Markdown source spans, links, attachments, configuration discovery, rebuildable index behavior, history retention and watcher reconciliation.
The foundation contracts compile with strict TypeScript checking.
No issues in the changed foundation files.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
State, contracts, architecture, strict typecheck, tests, Bun compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health reports 98.6/A with legacy status-script complexity advisories.

implemented: Arbitrary regular-file bytes and symlink metadata are retained in authoritative snapshots; derived indexes write only to app data.
Wikilinks, Markdown links and embeds retain aliases/subpaths and resolve resolved, ambiguous, unresolved and external targets.
Markdown property edits are span-based and preserve BOM, line endings and unrepresented source; attachments retain original binary paths and hashes.
Configuration discovery reads .obsidian and .obsidian-* JSON without writing the vault; watcher hints are followed by snapshot reconciliation.
History retention is a non-destructive plan and never schedules protected conflicts for deletion.
The VaultStore merge seam combines disjoint same-length UTF-8 line edits and preserves incoming bytes for overlapping or binary conflicts.
limitations: Properties parsing currently represents simple top-level YAML-like fields; full nested YAML editing and reference Obsidian behavior remain pending.
Stable identity mapping, watcher overflow/sleep recovery and Standard/Chronicle Git workflows remain pending; structural merge edits are conservatively reported as conflicts.
Only local macOS arm64 tests ran; cross-platform and reference-application checks remain pending.
